applicability: Each call has an invocation and response, and FIFO uses the order of effective enqueue operations.
law: An overlapping history admits at least one FIFO order consistent with real-time precedence.

input_strategy.actions: Enqueue one item, wait for its response, then overlap enqueue of a second item with a dequeue in separate processes. Drain the queue and record every result.

edge_cases: The completed first enqueue must precede both later operations.

oracle.method: Enumerate serial orders respecting the observed non-overlap edges, simulate each with a list, and require one order whose responses match. The first dequeue returns the first item.

known_wrong_implementations: Allow a later enqueue to overtake an already completed first enqueue.
